items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Is Reviewing A Separation Of Capital IQ
items.summary: S&P Global (NYSE:SPGI) has begun a review of options for its Capital IQ and associated data businesses within Market Intelligence. The process could lead to a spin-off, sale or other form of separation of these information services units. Management framed the move as part of a broader effort to focus resources on business lines seen as core to S&P Global’s portfolio.
